row.name: NetApp Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=1 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.11 tightness=0.71 base_volume_vs_leg=0.91 base_volume_vs_avg=0.89
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 1 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 13.7% vs its 20-SMA, 19.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Three recorded checklist failures — C (base is a single session, outside the required 3–20), RE (burst bar is only 51% of the prior 5-bar range, not an expansion), and VOL (volume came in at 71% of the prior session, not above it) — combine to undermine the setup's mechanical quality. The chart confirms these: the signal bar is a modest green candle in a long, extended uptrend with no visible consolidation box to speak of, and volume bars in the signal region are clearly lighter than the surrounding weeks. The 13.7% extension over the 20-SMA adds a qualitative concern about a visibly spent move after a 59-session, 47.6% leg.
claude.key_risk: Three simultaneous checklist failures (C, RE, VOL) with no real base and below-average volume mean there is no compression to release and no institutional conviction behind the burst bar.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of 237.15 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest and price drifts back below the prior day's close near 231.
